title: Enhanced performance of carbon-based CsPbI2Br perovskite solar cells using interfacial modifiers
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2228-2237
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00106D, Paper
Haoju Li, Yuhang Liang, Changzhong Wang, Guangli Liu, Huang Cheng, Raochen Xie, Longxiang Luo, Yannan Qian
3-TPT and 4-TPT modified CsPbI2Br, passivating defects and enhancing crystal quality, achieving PCEs of 13.78% and 14.15%. After 500 h at 30% humidity, they retained 81.8% and 85.7% of initial PCE, outperforming the unmodified device’s 50.6%.
